notes.title: Evomon World
notes.notes:
First of all it has been a pleasure to talk and make Evomon together with you this year. Your support and feedback have helped us improve and grow. Here’s to more fruitful collaborations in the new year that is coming. 

We would like to present to all of you some news about our new game that we are working on, [b]Evomon World[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/f9e9612ed1a32fc16e543d97e69a23a8122110a1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/187277bda43fce5759d06014f5f57020cc3384c9.gif[/img]


[b]Evomon World[/b] is our new game, a sequel to evomon, bringing everything we wanted, you will all have a new chance to explore Evotopia and meet the most diverse evomons in this new experience that is being created. 

We ask all of you for your support to make this project a reality , please stay tuned on the oficial discord we plan to release our kickstarter pre-launch project page really soon!

[b]Evomon official Discord[/b] : 
https://discord.gg/jbEhCQgX

[b]Happy holidays![/b] everyone!

notes.title: Evomon Final Major Update 1.2 - Pre-historic
notes.notes:
Welcome  to the Final [b]Major Update[/b] of [b]Evomon[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/ae3f95d524b21fc5de30a28371b98e3442e23c81.gif[/img]

In this Update we are going to explore the ancient secrets of Evotopia ! 

A [b]new Expedition[/b] full of secrets is available 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/6e1e75fbd5618407c2c0434ad7bdd3528c251965.gif[/img]

27 [b]New Evomons[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/cd2fbc1b0363d5704a0ede53f763090ad29f0a87.gif[/img]

A [b]New Misterious Fusion[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/0018128abeffeaadbc8374b238262ec43d964091.gif[/img]

[b]New Items [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/ee2db6ea32d4432b6c8408361be0820b9846274f.png[/img]

[b]New Furnitures[/b] to be found on the EvoStore gacha machine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/61f89ea3355011f57a43f20c1ba6a36f53f557fa.png[/img]

Evomini Major [b]sprite overhaul[/b] for the expedition mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/39ee9f627abe6d58079fdb60cdf2f10d32e9e406.gif[/img]

New [b]Mini-Game Medals[/b] Challenges
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/7764c76c67b2a6c695a8f5050ca5534e345f6fc8.gif[/img]

In this update we've also added [b]several improvements[/b] to the game based on your suggestions
- Several Graphics Polishments
   *New Game Studio Splash Art 
   *New Borders to Encapsulate the game
   *New Ui for money in-game
   *New Icons for showing frozen and evomon DNA
   *Arena Graphics polishment
   *Updated night backgrounds
   *Brand New Evolution Scene
   *You can now pet evomons (hearts animations) 

- Several [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
  *Fixed a bug where the game would crash during the Christmas Event
  *Fixed a bug where the expedition boss would stop moving 

- General [b]Balancement[/b]
  *We now need hammers to unlock new mini-games we get hammers after playing mini-games
  *less clicks to hatch evomons

After many improvements and content added, its time for us to move forward.
We are planning a sequel for the Evomon Series !
Join us on the official discord to know more! : https://discord.gg/h9ankrZa

notes.title: Major Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Welcome to update 1.1 of Evomon [/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/4e5143d254fb1d05ad700964aaee595cf6e21108.png[/img]

Back when i was a kid i remember going to my hometown square and trading my cards and toys with my friends
it was such a special feeling of interaction ✨ 

i'm trying to convey and bring back these feelings within Evomon

[h2] 📈 EvoTrade 📉[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/7a35fd4196aa9c38c5dfa62b39d7cbe55512ad35.png[/img]

1) [b]Evotrade[/b] will be the [b]first online feature[/b] on the Evomon game !
on the [b]Evotrade [/b]you will pay some coins to be able to trade any evomon you currently own wich your friends of Steam or any person that owns the game 
--------------------------
📨  There's also a neat chatbox where you will be able to talk with your friends inside the game! 
--------------------------

[h2]✨ Ara Evomons[/h2]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/4b71d4aab3c0394baf37fe704ae49a430a891c1f.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/a51524409bebe8f8191745fb27ec87df5984408c.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/bf7044982082f78bab6b535e4f3d5eb9932310c8.gif[/img]

2) ✨[b]Ara Evomons[/b]  ✨ 
This update will be coming together with the Ara Evomons update

✨ [b]Ara Evomons[/b] are very [b]rare Evomons[/b] that you can find (if you're lucky enough inside evoeggs and monster reviving)

and you will be able to trade your Aras with your friends and complete your evopedia!

[h3]Quests[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/fae200b9d467f07aa491ef4dbf2772c376c0d1dc.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/ea524e8e3cfaf9609c7b8f53bd1b590b943e37df.png[/img]

3) 2 New quests
There will be [b]2 new quests[/b] inside the game , which you'll be able to complete and get rewarded new evomons

[h3]New Evomons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/8489802cd3afc00bcbe76fc56f7d2c9667c43667.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/5a60b204e7cc64d86c3ef3a9fb5349ce51903ca9.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/c9a21f2813b6c0234e18680d4dfbdc602b75b4ce.gif[/img]

4) 30 New Evomons
We are adding 15 New Evomons and their Ara version in the game to collect and find making the Evopedia even larger.

[h3]General Polishment[/h3]

5) General gamefeel improvement / bug fixes
We will be polishing the game art and some of the mechanics to make the game loop much more enjoyable
we will be also fixing bugs reported by the players

[h3]New Artwork![/h3]

6) New Cover for the game
Last but not least, we got an amazing experienced monartist that will remake our Game imagery (new steam banners ! ✨)

We hope everyone enjoy the update and stay tuned on the discord community for new upcoming news
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/KhTz4wbhv7

notes.notes:

* Made the enemy attack the collision box of fire balls  much smaller so its now easier to escape,

notes.title: EXPEDITIONEER UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/63994090fc16660183a9fd61cbfca493e6676108.png[/img]

[h1][b]EXPEDITIONEER UPDATE[/b][/h1]
[b]Expedition Mode Update[/b]

We gladly present you the first update for evomon!


[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Added: Added evomons graphics in the expedition, we took the default tatamon graphics and now all evomons will appear in the expedition
[*]Added: Added evomons graphics in expedition battle
[*]Added: Freeplay mode in battle
[*]Added: New item in Evoshop the XPNATOR
[*]Added: New achievement in the gacha machine
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/7d487710f8f947ce4a6fce9edded1eb0a5e25eb5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/037ea138cfbf479e3d9fbccca806b047d7e6f6c8.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/a8267712ab53bcd76695f7851fd6a6db2ef02637.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvement: expedition mode now gives experience to your evomon 
[*] Improvement : the more expeditions you unlock, the higher will be your expedition energy
[*] Improvement : Balance in the Arena battles
[*] Improvement : General improvements as requested by the players
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugfix : bug fixed that the gacha doll was being distributed incorrectly
[*] Bugfix : bug fixed when editing mode with evopedia open
[*] Bugfix : text and translation
[/list]

[b]Known issue: [/b]
Unfortunately, due to a problem with our game engine, during the update we had a problem with saved indexes in room savegames
so if you had items in your room they will probably be reset.
PS: as a bonus we are giving everyone a tatamon plushie for each room.
